name: PEADReplication
what_it_holds: Academic-style replication and out-of-sample extension of Bernard & Thomas (1989) PEAD, with notebooks (notebooks_OOS, notebooks_sample), a write-up PDF, and papers/ folder; confirmed via directory listing that the committed data/ folder is empty (only a .DS_Store) — the pipeline is WRDS-dependent and ships no usable data.
why_useful: Well-documented replication methodology for PEAD if the team wants to reproduce SUE-decile drift tests, but contributes no free data of its own.

name: Gyódi (2021) "Airbnb and hotels during COVID-19" + "Spatial Patterns of Airbnb Offers, Hotels and Attractions" (Zenodo supplementary materials)
what_it_holds: Zenodo-hosted supplementary materials for two Kristóf Gyódi papers: one comparing Airbnb vs hotel pricing/supply flexibility across nine European cities Jan 2018-Sep 2020 (COVID shock), the other on spatial clustering of Airbnb offers vs hotels/attractions across multiple cities. The COVID record itself only has a PDF attached (no raw CSV); the spatial-patterns record is titled '...Supplementary Materials' and may carry data files not confirmed here.
why_useful: The COVID paper's 2018-2020 European city-level Airbnb/hotel supply-and-price series would predate and extend our current European coverage if the underlying data (not just the PDF) can be tracked down from the author; flagged for a human to check the actual Zenodo file list before relying on it.
size_hint: PDF only confirmed (1.2MB); data files unconfirmed

name: earnings_news_jar
what_it_holds: Code (59% Python, 41% Jupyter Notebook) accompanying the paper "How Is Earnings News Transmitted to Stock Prices?" — an academic replication package studying earnings-announcement information transmission, not company-specific but a methods reference for event-study construction around earnings prints.
why_useful: Relevant to gap #17 (event-study packages, earnings-implied-move estimators) as a citable academic methodology repo, though it is general-market rather than travel/OTA-specific.
themes: Company KPI and alt-data backtest repos for ABNB or OTAs: anyone who already assembled Airbnb quarterly KPI datasets, consensus, or alt-data panels
